claim: A foreign resident can bring a spouse who is not legally separated and is at least 18.
quote: coniuge non legalmente separato e di età non inferiore ai diciotto anni

claim: Minor unmarried children (also the spouse's or born outside marriage) can be brought, if the other parent, if living, consents.
quote: figli minori, anche del coniuge o nati fuori del matrimonio, non coniugati, a condizione che l'altro genitore, qualora esistente, abbia dato il suo consenso

claim: Adult children can be brought only if dependent because of a health condition amounting to total disability.
quote: figli maggiorenni a carico, qualora per ragioni oggettive non possano provvedere alle proprie indispensabili esigenze di vita in ragione del loro stato di salute che comporti invalidità totale

claim: Parents can be brought if dependent and with no other children in the home country, or if over 65 and the other children cannot support them for documented serious health reasons.
quote: genitori a carico, qualora non abbiano altri figli nel Paese di origine o di provenienza, ovvero genitori ultrasessantacinquenni, qualora gli altri figli siano impossibilitati al loro sostentamento per documentati, gravi motivi di salute
note: News F (migrationconcern, 28 Nov 2025) says parents were removed; the text in force on 10 Nov 2026 still lists them.

claim: A child counts as a minor if under 18 on the date the application is filed.
quote: si considerano minori i figli di età inferiore a diciotto anni al momento della presentazione dell'istanza di ricongiungimento

claim: A second wife cannot be brought if the husband already lives in Italy with another wife (the same bar applies to parents in that case).
quote: Non è consentito il ricongiungimento dei familiari di cui alle lettere a) e d) del comma 1, quando il familiare di cui si chiede il ricongiungimento è coniugato con un cittadino straniero regolarmente soggiornante con altro coniuge nel territorio nazionale

claim: The sponsor must hold a long-term card or a permit of at least one year for employment, self-employment, international protection, study, religious or family reasons.
quote: agli stranieri titolari di carta di soggiorno o di permesso di soggiorno di durata non inferiore a un anno rilasciato per motivi di lavoro subordinato o autonomo

claim: Since 11 December 2024 the sponsor (except people with international protection) must have two years' uninterrupted legal residence in Italy before applying for a spouse, a disabled adult child or a parent; minor children are not covered by this rule.
quote: devono avere maturato, al momento della richiesta di ricongiungimento per i familiari di cui all'articolo 29, comma 1, lettere a), c) e d), un periodo ininterrotto di soggiorno legale di almeno due anni nel territorio nazionale
value: 2 years (spouse, disabled adult child, parent); none for minor children
note: Text in force from 11-12-2024 per Normattiva.

claim: The two-year rule has been in force since 11 December 2024.
quote: Testo in vigore dal: 11-12-2024

claim: The sponsor needs housing that meets health and hygiene standards and suitability for living, checked by the comune's offices.
quote: di un alloggio conforme ai requisiti igienico-sanitari, nonché di idoneità abitativa, accertati dai competenti uffici comunali

claim: For one child under 14, the consent of the owner of the home where the child will live is enough instead of the housing check.
quote: Nel caso di un figlio di età inferiore agli anni quattordici al seguito di uno dei genitori, è sufficiente il consenso del titolare dell'alloggio nel quale il minore effettivamente dimorerà

claim: Minimum lawful annual income: the annual assegno sociale plus half of it for each family member to be brought.
quote: non inferiore all'importo annuo dell'assegno sociale aumentato della metà dell'importo dell'assegno sociale per ogni familiare da ricongiungere

claim: For two or more children under 14, income must in any case be at least twice the annual assegno sociale.
quote: Per il ricongiungimento di due o più figli di età inferiore agli anni quattordici è richiesto, in ogni caso, un reddito non inferiore al doppio dell'importo annuo dell'assegno sociale

claim: The income of family members living with the sponsor also counts.
quote: Ai fini della determinazione del reddito si tiene conto anche del reddito annuo complessivo dei familiari conviventi con il richiedente

claim: For a parent over 65, the sponsor must also have health insurance covering all risks in Italy, or SSN enrolment for a fee.
quote: di una assicurazione sanitaria o di altro titolo idoneo, a garantire la copertura di tutti i rischi nel territorio nazionale a favore dell'ascendente ultrasessantacinquenne

claim: The assegno sociale for 2026 is EUR 546.24 a month for 13 months.
quote: L’importo dell’Assegno per il 2026 è pari a 546,24 euro per 13 mensilità

claim: The annual assegno sociale for 2026 is EUR 7,101.12; family reunification income: EUR 10,651.68 for one family member, EUR 14,202.24 for two, EUR 17,752.80 for three (each extra member adds EUR 3,550.56).
quote: 7.101,12 euro se non coniugato
note: Thresholds computed from INPS annual amount with Art. 29 c.3 b) formula [F0012].

claim: Twice the 2026 annual assegno sociale is EUR 14,202.24 (the floor for two or more children under 14).
quote: elevato a 14.202,24 euro se è coniugato

claim: The application for the family nulla osta is sent online to the SUI at the Prefettura for the sponsor's place of residence.
quote: è inviata, con modalità informatiche, allo Sportello unico per l'immigrazione presso la prefettura - ufficio territoriale del Governo competente per il luogo di dimora del richiedente

claim: The SUI must issue the family nulla osta within 150 days of the application (raised from 90 days by Decree-Law 146/2025).
quote: Il nulla osta al ricongiungimento familiare è rilasciato entro ((centocinquanta giorni)) dalla richiesta

claim: The visa is issued only after the Italian consulate actually verifies the authenticity of the documents proving the relationship, marriage, minor age or health.
quote: Il rilascio del visto nei confronti del familiare per il quale è stato rilasciato il predetto nulla osta è subordinato all'effettivo accertamento dell'autenticità, da parte dell'autorità consolare italiana, della documentazione comprovante i presupposti di parentela, coniugio, minore età o stato di salute

claim: Where documents are doubtful, the consulate can certify the relationship on the basis of a DNA test paid for by the family.
quote: sulla base dell'esame del DNA (acido desossiribonucleico), effettuato a spese degli interessati

claim: The DNA route applies to children and parents when there are well-founded doubts about the authenticity of the foreign documents.
quote: quando sussistano fondati dubbi sulla autenticità della predetta documentazione

claim: The application is refused if the marriage or adoption was only to get entry or residence in Italy.
quote: La richiesta di ricongiungimento familiare è respinta se è accertato che il matrimonio o l'adozione hanno avuto luogo allo scopo esclusivo di consentire all'interessato di entrare o soggiornare nel territorio dello Stato

claim: An asylum seeker whose claim is not finally decided cannot apply for family reunification.
quote: quando il soggiornante chiede il riconoscimento dello status di rifugiato e la sua domanda non è ancora stata oggetto di una decisione definitiva

claim: Family can also enter together with a worker who holds an entry visa for an employment contract of at least one year (familiari al seguito), with the same housing and income conditions.
quote: È consentito l'ingresso, al seguito dello straniero titolare di carta di soggiorno o di un visto di ingresso per lavoro subordinato relativo a contratto di durata non inferiore a un anno

claim: The application is filed only online on the Ministry of the Interior's site nullaostalavoro.dlci.interno.it.
quote: can only be submitted exclusively by computerized procedure through the dedicated wed site of the Ministry of internal affairs: https://nullaostalavoro.dlci.interno.it

claim: Forms to attach include S1 (housing for children under 14), S2 (housing), S3 and S3 bis (employer statements).
quote: Form S1 for accommodation of children under 14 years old.

claim: The SUI checks with the Questura for any bar such as criminal convictions, then examines applications in order of arrival.
quote: the Territorial Government Office will examine family reunification applications in a chronological order of arrival

claim: If papers are missing, a notice on the ALI portal gives a date to come to the SUI with the missing papers and the originals; if they are still incomplete that day, the application is rejected.
quote: in case that on the day and time indicated in the appointment notice, the required documents are incomplete, the application will be rejected

claim: If papers are incomplete or a requirement is not met, the sponsor gets a notice of intended rejection on the ALI portal.
quote: the person concerned receives a notification of the rejection of the application on the “ALI portal”

claim: If complete, the SUI sends the entry clearance electronically to the embassy, visible on the ALI portal.
quote: will electronically send the “entry clearance” to the relevant embassy. This will be contextually visible on the ALI Portal

claim: The nulla osta is valid for 6 months and cannot be extended or renewed.
quote: This period cannot be extended and on the expiry date it will not be renewed

claim: The family member has 6 months to book an appointment at the Italian Embassy and apply for the visa.
quote: The family member to be reunified therefore has 6 months to book an appointment at the Italian Embassy in the country of origin and apply for a visa

claim: The host must present a written declaration of hospitality to the police or comune within 48 hours of the family member's arrival.
quote: The applicant or the host has to present a written declaration of hospitality, within 48 hours of arrival of the family member in Italy, to the local authority for public security

claim: Within 8 days of arrival (the passport stamp is the proof) the sponsor books an SUI appointment on the ALI portal, under book an appointment, with the SPID used for the application.
quote: Within 8 days of the arrival of the family member in Italy (the stamp on the passport will be used as proof), the applicant has to book an appointment on the Territorial Government Office’s website “portale ALI”, in the section “book an appointment”

claim: At the SUI appointment the entry is registered and the residence permit papers are completed.
quote: register the entry into Italy and complete the issuing of the residence permit documents

claim: The sponsor needs SPID (free digital identity), registered with an email, a mobile number, a valid ID and the health card with the tax code.
quote: To register, you will need: an email address; a mobile phone number; a valid ID; and a health card with your tax code

claim: The sponsor buys a EUR 16 revenue stamp (marca da bollo) and enters its number in the online form.
quote: Purchase a 16.00 euro revenue stamp (marca da bollo)

claim: At the SUI appointment the sponsor brings the original stamp, a second EUR 16 stamp for the nulla osta, the permit and a copy.
quote: Another €16.00 revenue stamp to be affixed to the Nulla Osta

claim: After the nulla osta is issued, the sponsor sends the original to the family member; the SUI also sends it electronically to the embassy.
quote: Once you have obtained the Nulla Osta, you must send the original to your family member

claim: Personal papers for the nulla osta: passport pages of the sponsor and the family members, the valid permit (or expired permit with the renewal receipt), the codice fiscale and the family status certificate.
quote: carta di soggiorno o permesso di soggiorno in corso di validità, ovvero, permesso scaduto, con allegata ricevuta di presentazione dell’istanza di rinnovo

claim: A rental contract must run at least six months from the application date and be registered.
quote: contratto di affitto che deve essere di durata non inferiore a sei mesi a decorrere dalla data di presentazione della domanda

claim: The comune's housing suitability certificate for family reunification, or the receipt of the request showing the RIA code, must be attached.
quote: certificato di idoneità alloggiativa rilasciato dal Comune per finalità di ricongiungimento familiare oppure copia della ricevuta di richiesta del certificato indicante il codice RIA

claim: The holder(s) of the home sign form S2 consenting to host the family members too, with a signed ID copy.
quote: attestante il consenso ad ospitare anche i ricongiunti

claim: Employees attach the last tax return or CUD (all payslips if employed under a year), the contract or Unilav, the last three payslips, and the employer's S3 statement dated within one month.
quote: in caso di attività intrapresa da oltre un anno: ultima dichiarazione dei redditi, oppure, ultimo CUD o modello UNICO; in caso di attività intrapresa da meno di un anno, devono essere allegate tutte le buste paga

claim: The employer's S3 statement must be dated within one month and show the job is current and the monthly pay.
quote: autocertificazione del datore di lavoro, redatta su modello “S3” con data non anteriore di mesi 1

claim: For a parent over 65, the sponsor signs an undertaking to take out health insurance.
quote: dichiarazione di impegno a sottoscrivere una polizza assicurativa sanitaria

claim: In Rome the housing certificate is requested online on the Prefettura di Roma's RIA site, then the printed request and documents are handed in at the Municipio.
quote: Modulo di richiesta di idoneità alloggiativa, compilare on-line allink della Prefettura di Roma - UTG

claim: The printed request with the list of attached documents is delivered to the Municipio.
quote: stampare l'istanza con l'elenco dei documenti allegati e consegnare in Municipio

claim: Spouse, children under 18 and parents can apply for the family reunion visa at VFS Dhaka; a nulla osta is mandatory.
quote: A Nulla Osta as the authorization of applying for this visa is a mandatory document.

claim: The family reunion visa fee is Tk 16,240 (EUR 116).
quote: Visa Fee | 16240 | 116

claim: VFS adds a service charge of Tk 5,320 (EUR 38), VAT included.
quote: VFS Global Service Charge | 5320 | 38

claim: A bank draft charge of Tk 270 is added.
quote: Bank Draft Charge | 270

claim: VFS converts fees at EUR 1 = Tk 140.
quote: Exchange rate - 1 Euro = 140

claim: VFS states a minimum of 21 calendar days for a family reunion visa.
quote: Minimum 21 Calendar Days required for applying Family Re-Union Visa.

claim: VFS asks for a machine-readable passport valid 1 year and 6 months with two blank pages and copies of all passports.
quote: Passport (MRP) should be valid for 1year and 6 months

claim: VFS asks for copies of all the sponsor's passports (all pages), and the sponsor's permit and Italian ID card attested by the comune or Questura.
quote: Valid Soggiorno photocopy and Carta d’ Identita attested from Commune/Kostura in Italy

claim: A family certificate from the Union Parishad chairman or ward commissioner in the Embassy's format is required.
quote: Family certificate from chairman/commissioner according to the embassy format.

claim: The family certificate is issued in the name of the living head of the family, lists all immediate family members senior to junior, marks dead members 'late', and gives real addresses (Italian address for a member living in Italy).
quote: Certificate should be issued by head of the family name.

claim: Name, father's name and date of birth must be identical in every document, with no exceptions.
quote: Name, Father’s name, Date of birth should be same in all documents. NO exception will be acceptable.

claim: If the marriage was by phone or video, the nikahnama must say so and show the kazi was physically present.
quote: In case of marriage took place over phone/video conference, marriage certificate/nikahnama should contain that information with evidence of kazi’s physical presence.

claim: For a spouse visa the applicant must prove the husband or wife was in Bangladesh for the wedding, with arrival and departure stamps in passport copies.
quote: In case of spouse visa applicant has to prove that his/her husband/wife came in Bangladesh during marriage ceremony by providing arrival and departure seal in passport photocopy

claim: The applicant's passport must show the correct spouse name.
quote: Applicant’s passport should contain correct spouse name on the passport.

claim: Parents joining a child need a dependent certificate from the local chairman or commissioner (or a lawyer on stamp paper).
quote: This certificate is applicable for the parents who are entiled to join their children in Italy.

claim: No correction fluid or overwriting; bring all originals and the original NID or study certificate.
quote: Do not use any fluid or overwrite in the documentation.

claim: Long-stay (D) visa applicants do not give fingerprints.
quote: Biometric Exemption: Applicants applying for long term visa are exempted from giving fingerprints.

claim: The Embassy's July 2026 checklist requires the nikahnama (Bangla and English) and marriage certificate in original and apostilled.
quote: English (original and Apostilled)

claim: The family certificate from the local chairman or commissioner must be original and apostilled.
quote: commissioner Original and Apostilled

claim: Only one apostille per document is accepted.
quote: ONLY ONE APOSTILLE FOR EACH DOCUMENT WILL BE ACCEPTED.

claim: The checklist asks for the D-type form, one ICAO photo, a passport valid 3 months beyond the visa with two blank pages, the nulla osta copy and a one-way ticket booking.
quote: One way airline ticket booking with Passenger Registration Number or Reservation

claim: The passport must be valid at least three months beyond the visa's expiry and have two blank pages.
quote: Passport must be valid for at least additional three months from the date of expiry of the visa's validity

claim: Copies of all previous passports of the sponsor in Italy are required.
quote: ALL THE COPIES OF THE PREVIOUS PASSPORTS OF THE INVITER IN ITALY

claim: The marriage certificate must give the solemnisation date (nikahnama column 12), the registration date (column 24), and volume, page and serial number.
quote: Marriage solemnized date (Column no. 12 of "Nikah Nama") and marriage registration date (Column no. 24 of "Nikah Nama")

claim: If either spouse married before, the apostilled talaknama proving the first marriage ended is required.
quote: documents proving the legal dissolution of the 1st marriage (divorce certificate

claim: A minor joining a parent needs both parents' consent, apostilled, and court papers for any legal guardian.
quote: Consent of both parents or custodian, apostilled.

claim: Recommended for spouses: certified copies of all pages of all the sponsor's passports since the marriage and ID of all wedding witnesses.
quote: Certified copy of all pages of all passports owned by the spouse residing in Italy since the date of the marriage

claim: For phone or video marriages, the ID and Italian residence permits of all witnesses in Italy.
quote: Id documents and Residence permit of all the witnesses in Italy in case of Telephonic/ video Marriages

claim: Only spouses, children under 18, parents under 65 with no other children in Bangladesh and dependent parents over 65 are eligible.
quote: Only spouses, children below 18 years, parents below 65 years with no other children in Bangladesh and dependent parents above 65 years are eligible

claim: The same applicant cannot file two visa applications at once, even with two passports.
quote: The same applicant cannot submit more than one visa application at the same time

claim: The Embassy can ask for documents not on the checklist.
quote: The Embassy reserves itself the right to request any supplementary document

claim: The older VFS checklist required documents legalised by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and by the Italian Embassy, with legalisation payable at VFS.
quote: can pay the legalization fee together with the visa application directly to VFS Global
note: Superseded by the Embassy's July 2026 checklist requiring apostille [esteri-ambdhaka-family-reunion-sui-2026-07].

claim: When the Embassy asks for more documents, VFS updates the passport tracker and gives a deadline; wrong phone numbers or emails are the applicant's fault.
quote: VFS Global updates the content of the passport tracker when additional documents are requested and provides a deadline for their submission.

claim: Passports not collected from VFS within 90 days go back to the Embassy and then to Bangladesh's Ministry of Home Affairs.
quote: it is their responsibility to collect their passports at VFS Global within 90 days

claim: Uncollected passports are forwarded to the Ministry of Home Affairs.
quote: forward them to the competent national authorities (Ministry of Home Affairs)

claim: The Embassy issues about 12,000 to 13,000 family reunification visas a year (September 2026).
quote: approximately 12,000 to 13,000 being issued every year at present

claim: Family members can work in Italy once they arrive.
quote: family members can work in Italy once they arrive as family dependants

claim: On fresh authorisations the rejection rate has been small in recent years.
quote: For fresh authorisations, in recent years we have not had a significant rejection rate.

claim: In May 2025 the Embassy said 2025 family files were a priority.
quote: processing of family reunion visa applications for 2025 on priority basis

claim: A Bangla news site reported in November 2025 that only spouses and minor children could now be brought, not parents.
quote: পারিবারিক ভিসার ক্ষেত্রে এখন থেকে কেবল স্বামী-স্ত্রী এবং নাবালক সন্তানদেরই আনা যাবে
note: Conflicts with Art. 29 c.1 d) in force on 10 Nov 2026 and the Dhaka checklist of July 2026, which still include parents.

claim: The same report said the nulla osta time limit went from 90 to 150 days.
quote: ৯০ দিন থেকে বাড়িয়ে ১৫০ দিন করা হয়েছে

claim: The family permit allows employed or self-employed work, study and registering at job centres.
quote: lo svolgimento di lavoro subordinato o autonomo

claim: The family permit lasts as long as the sponsor's permit and is renewed with it.
quote: ha la stessa durata del permesso di soggiorno del familiare straniero in possesso dei requisiti per il ricongiungimento ai sensi dell'articolo 29 ed è rinnovabile insieme con quest'ultimo

claim: If the sponsor dies, or on legal separation or divorce, the family permit can be converted to a work or study permit.
quote: il permesso di soggiorno può essere convertito in permesso per lavoro subordinato, per lavoro autonomo o per studio

claim: A refusal of the family nulla osta or family permit can be challenged before the ordinary court.
quote: l'interessato può proporre opposizione all'autorità giudiziaria ordinaria

claim: A foreigner legally resident at least one year who marries an Italian, EU citizen or legal resident in Italy can get a family permit.
quote: agli stranieri regolarmente soggiornanti ad altro titolo da almeno un anno che abbiano contratto matrimonio nel territorio dello Stato con cittadini italiani o di uno Stato membro dell'Unione europea, ovvero con cittadini stranieri regolarmente soggiornanti

claim: Such a permit is revoked at once if the couple do not actually live together, unless they have a child.
quote: è immediatamente revocato qualora sia accertato che al matrimonio non è seguita l'effettiva convivenza salvo che dal matrimonio sia nata prole

claim: A legally resident family member can convert their own permit to a family permit within one year of its expiry, if the sponsor meets the requirements.
quote: La conversione può essere richiesta entro un anno dalla data di scadenza del titolo di soggiorno originariamente posseduto dal familiare

claim: A foreign parent of an Italian child living in Italy gets a family permit even without a valid permit.
quote: al genitore straniero, anche naturale, di minore italiano residente in Italia

claim: Family members of an EU or Italian citizen (spouse, parents, parents-in-law, children under 21) apply for an EU family member visa at VFS.
quote: Children less than 21 years old

claim: The visa fee and VFS charge are waived for family members dependent on the EU citizen, with proof.
quote: Visa fee and VFS Global service charge is not applicable for the applicants who are dependent on EU/EEU citizen upon submitting necessary supporting document/s.

claim: The EU family checklist needs an invitation letter from the EU or Italian citizen stating the intention to exercise the right to family unity, with ID.
quote: The letter has to state the intention the Italian/EU family member to exercise the right to family

claim: A spouse needs the extract of the marriage certificate from the Italian comune plus the apostilled nikahnama and marriage certificate.
quote: Extract of the Marriage Certificate issued by the Italian Municipality + apostilled

claim: After three months, the non-EU family member of an EU citizen applies to the Questura for the residence card of a family member of an EU citizen.
quote: trascorsi tre mesi dall'ingresso nel territorio nazionale, richiedono alla questura competente per territorio di residenza

claim: The card is valid five years.
quote: ha una validità di cinque anni dalla data del rilascio

claim: The card is free apart from the cost of the printed forms.
quote: Il rilascio della carta di soggiorno di cui al comma 1 è gratuito, salvo il rimborso del costo degli stampati

claim: A birth is declared within 3 days at the hospital's health management, or within 10 days at the comune where the birth took place.
quote: La dichiarazione può essere resa, entro dieci giorni dalla nascita, presso il comune nel cui territorio è avvenuto il parto o in alternativa, entro tre giorni, presso la direzione sanitaria dell'ospedale

claim: Parents can instead declare the birth within 10 days at their own comune of residence.
quote: hanno facoltà di dichiarare, entro dieci giorni dal parto, la nascita nel proprio comune di residenza

claim: A minor child living with a legally resident parent follows that parent's status and gets a family permit valid until 18 (or an EU long-term permit).
quote: Al minore è rilasciato un permesso di soggiorno per motivi familiari valido fino al compimento della maggiore età ovvero un permesso di soggiorno UE per soggiornanti di lungo periodo

claim: The juvenile court can authorise a family member to enter or stay for a set time for serious reasons linked to a child in Italy.
quote: per gravi motivi connessi con lo sviluppo psicofisico e tenuto conto dell'età e delle condizioni di salute del minore che si trova nel territorio italiano, può autorizzare l'ingresso o la permanenza del familiare, per un periodo di tempo determinato

claim: Italian citizenship passes by blood: a child born in Italy to foreign parents is not Italian at birth, except residual cases (stateless or unknown parents, or parents who cannot pass on their nationality).
quote: La cittadinanza italiana si acquista iure sanguinis, cioè se si nasce o si è adottati da cittadini italiani

claim: A foreigner born in Italy who lived there legally without a break until 18 becomes Italian by declaring it within one year of turning 18.
quote: Lo straniero nato in Italia, che vi abbia risieduto legalmente senza interruzioni fino al raggiungimento della maggiore età, diviene cittadino se dichiara di voler acquistare la cittadinanza italiana entro un anno dalla suddetta data

claim: A foreigner born in Italy can apply for citizenship after three years' legal residence.
quote: allo straniero che è nato nel territorio della Repubblica che vi risiede legalmente da almeno tre anni

claim: A child born in Italy is given a Bangladeshi birth registration certificate by applying online at bdris.gov.bd for the Embassy in Rome (or from the permanent address in Bangladesh).
quote: বাংলাদেশ দূতাবাস হতে জন্ম নিবন্ধন সনদ সংগ্রহ করতে চাইলে bdris.gov.bd ওয়েবসাইটে প্রবেশ করে অনলাইনে আবেদন করুন

claim: With the printed online application, submit the Italian birth certificate naming the child and both parents, and copies of both parents' passports.
quote: ইতালির যথাযথ কর্তৃপক্ষ থেকে প্রদত্ত জন্ম সনদ (যেখানে সন্তান এবং বাবা-মা তিনজনের নাম উল্লেখ আছে), বাবা ও মায়ের পাসপোর্টের ফটোকপি

claim: The online application is deleted from the system after 15 days if not submitted.
quote: অনলাইনে আবেদন জমা দেয়ার পরে তা ১৫ দিন যাবত সিস্টেম (সফটওয়্যার)-এ সংরক্ষিত থাকে, এরপর তা স্বয়ংক্রিয় ভাবে মুছে যায়

claim: The Embassy usually takes 5 working days to prepare the birth registration certificate.
quote: বাংলাদেশ দূতাবাসে জন্ম নিবন্ধন সার্টিফিকেট প্রস্তুত করতে সাধারণত ৫ কর্মদিবস সময় প্রয়োজন

claim: The baby does not need to come for the birth registration.
quote: জন্ম নিবন্ধন সনদ তৈরি করতে শিশু সন্তানকে আনতে হবে না

claim: Registering the same person's birth twice is an offence under section 21 of the Births and Deaths Registration Act 2004.
quote: একই ব্যক্তির অনুকূলে একাধিকবার জন্ম নিবন্ধন করা যাবে না

claim: For the child's first passport: fill the form on passport.gov.bd, choose Skip Payment, and bring the birth registration certificate, a copy of the Italian birth certificate, the parents' passport copies and photos.
quote: খ) ইতালিয়ান জন্ম সনদের ফটোকপি

claim: When the online passport form asks for payment, click Skip Payment; the Embassy enters the fee itself.
quote: স্কিপ পেমেন্ট (Skip Payment) বক্সটি ক্লিক করে পরবর্তী ধাপে যান

claim: A new passport or renewal costs EUR 100 for a child or an adult.
quote: নতুন পাসপোর্ট তৈরী এবং পাসপোর্ট নবায়ন (শিশু বা প্রাপ্তবয়স্ক) উভয় ক্ষেত্রেই ফি ১০০ ইউরো

claim: The Embassy takes fees by bank card, not cash.
quote: দূতাবাসে ব্যাংক-কার্ডের মাধ্যমে ফি প্রদান করার জন্য সকলকে অনুরধ করা যাচ্ছে

claim: A child under 2 getting a first passport does not need to come; over 2 the child must come.
quote: বাচ্চার যদি প্রথম এমআরপি পাসপোর্ট করতে হয় এবং বাচ্চার বয়স যদি দুই (২) বছরের কম হয় সে ক্ষেত্রে বাচ্চাকে সাথে আনার প্রয়োজন নেই

claim: The passport is printed in Dhaka and usually reaches the Embassy within 2 months of enrolment; there is no urgent service.
quote: সাধারণত পাসপোর্টের এনরোলমেন্ট করার পরে ২ মাসের মধ্যে পাসপোর্ট প্রিন্ট হয়ে দূতাবাসে চলে আসে

claim: One appointment covers the whole family (self, spouse, children, parents).
quote: পরিবারের সকল সদস্যদের জন্য একটি এপয়েন্টমেন্ট যথেষ্ট

claim: The Embassy's birth registration page links to bdris.gov.bd and lists the Italian birth record (atto di nascita), both parents' passport copies and an Italian document as mandatory.
quote: https://bdris.gov.bd/

claim: A child with an Italian passport needs a No Visa Required seal to enter Bangladesh: online form at visa.gov.bd, documents emailed to bdvisa.rome@gmail.com, then an appointment.
quote: Scan and send to the e-mail address bdvisa.rome@gmail.com

claim: For children without a Bangladeshi passport, the NVR needs the Bangladeshi birth certificate and the parents' Bangladeshi passport copies.
quote: For children without MRP, please send the birth certificate from Bangladesh and copies of the parents BD passports

claim: The NVR seal costs EUR 50 per passport.
quote: 50 euro (per passport)

claim: The NVR seal is issued after 5 working days.
quote: The visa will be issued after 5 working days

claim: A non-EU foreigner can be granted citizenship after ten years' legal residence.
quote: allo straniero che risiede legalmente da almeno dieci anni nel territorio della Repubblica

claim: Non-EU citizens need ten years' uninterrupted legal residence.
quote: Per il cittadino extracomunitario occorre la residenza legale in Italia ininterrotta da almeno dieci anni

claim: Legal residence means being registered as resident at the comune and in order with residence permit rules for the whole period.
quote: deve risultare anagraficamente residente e in regola con gli adempimenti previsti dalle norme in materia di soggiorno degli stranieri in Italia per tutto il periodo richiesto

claim: The applicant must prove sufficient income, no criminal record and no security bar.
quote: il richiedente deve dimostrare di avere redditi sufficienti al sostentamento, di non avere precedenti penali

claim: Citizenship by residence or marriage requires Italian at level B1 or higher.
quote: non inferiore al livello B1 del Quadro comune europeo di riferimento per la conoscenza delle lingue (QCER)

claim: B1 can be proved by an Italian school diploma, a certificate from a recognised body, or a CPIA (adult education centre) attestation.
quote: attestazione rilasciata da uno dei Centri Provinciali per l'Istruzione degli Adulti (CPIA)

claim: Holders of the EU long-term permit, or people who signed the integration agreement, are exempt from proving B1.
quote: i titolari di permesso di soggiorno UE oppure CE per soggiornanti di lungo periodo

claim: A citizenship application costs a EUR 250 contribution.
quote: sono soggette al pagamento di un contributo di importo pari a 250 euro

claim: The EUR 250 is paid with a pre-printed bollettino at the post office, by bank transfer or via PagoPA when filing online.
quote: Presso gli Uffici Postali, dove sono disponibili gli appositi bollettini già predisposti, o tramite bonifico, oppure tramite la piattaforma PagoPA

claim: Since 18 June 2015 applications are only online on portaleservizi.dlci.interno.it.
quote: Dal 18 giugno 2015 l’istanza può essere presentata solo on line

claim: The home-country criminal record certificate is valid six months from issue; the birth certificate does not expire.
quote: Il certificato penale del Paese d’origine ha una validità di sei mesi dalla data di rilascio

claim: Names must be identical in Italian and foreign documents; discrepancies need a consular attestation legalised by the Prefettura.
quote: Le generalità riportate sia nei documenti italiani che in quelli stranieri devono essere le stesse in tutti gli atti

claim: The grant decree is notified on the SEND digital notifications platform with instructions for the oath.
quote: Il decreto di concessione viene inviato all’utente, con valore di notifica, tramite la Piattaforma Notifiche Digitali

claim: Whether the original citizenship is kept depends on the law of the home country.
quote: Il mantenimento o meno della cittadinanza di origine dipende dalle norme vigenti nello Stato di origine del richiedente

claim: The authorities must decide within 24 months, extendable to 36.
quote: fissato in ((ventiquattro mesi prorogabili fino al massimo di trentasei mesi)) dalla data di presentazione della domanda

claim: The spouse of an Italian can apply after two years' legal residence in Italy after marriage (three years if living abroad), halved if they have children.
quote: quando, dopo il matrimonio, risieda legalmente da almeno due anni nel territorio della Repubblica, oppure dopo tre anni dalla data del matrimonio se residente all'estero

claim: These periods are halved when the couple have children.
quote: I termini di cui al comma 1 sono ridotti della metà in presenza di figli nati o adottati dai coniugi

claim: The June 2025 referendum to cut the residence requirement from 10 to 5 years failed: no quorum.
quote: Nessuno dei referendum sul lavoro e sulla cittadinanza ha raggiunto il quorum

claim: The citizenship question proposed reducing the residence period from 10 to 5 years.
quote: ridurre da 10 a 5 gli anni di residenza regolare

claim: The Apostille Convention entered into force for Bangladesh on 30 March 2025.
quote: On 30 March 2025, the Convention of 5 October 1961 Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents (1961 Apostille Convention) entered into force for the People’s Republic of Bangladesh

claim: In May 2025 the Embassy said it was detecting growing numbers of fake Bangladeshi and Italian civil status documents in family reunion applications.
quote: the Embassy is detecting increasing numbers of fake Bangladeshi and Italian civil status documents

claim: A forged document leads to refusal and a flag in the Schengen system with a permanent effect on future EU travel.
quote: will also cause the applicant to be flagged within the common system shared by Schengen Countries, with permanent impact on the possibilities of future legal travel to the European Union

claim: In May 2025 the Embassy was clearing a 2024 backlog of family files, giving priority to urgent cases such as minors or humanitarian situations.
quote: the Embassy is working to clear the 2024 backlog by implementing chronological and thematic priority criteria, including the processing of demonstrable urgent cases, such as those involving minors or humanitarian situations

claim: Check that the family members' name, surname, sex and date of birth on the nulla osta are correct, to avoid long visa delays.
quote: si prega di voler controllare l'esattezza dei dati anagrafici dei richiedenti (nome, cognome, sesso e data di nascita)
